findings.highlight: Tohsaka said there were no deaths, but that might just be the official story.
findings.evidenceJa: 死傷者はいないと遠坂は言っていたが、それは表面だけの話だ。
findings.governingReading: He recalls her no-casualties statement as only a surface assessment, then considers continuing harm.
findings.explanation: No dead or injured on the surface becomes no deaths in an official story.

findings.highlight: Just wishing for a do-over because things didn't go well, or were so terrible they should never have happened...is pathetic.
findings.evidenceJa: 都合の悪い事だから、目の当てられない惨状だったから、その前に戻ってやり直せればなんて、ひどい侮辱だ。
findings.governingReading: The wish to undo an unpleasant catastrophe is condemned as a gross insult.

findings.highlight: The frigid winter air dispels my drowsiness almost instantly.
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい冬の大気は、眠気と不安を削ぎ落としてくれた。
findings.governingReading: Winter air strips away both drowsiness and anxiety.
findings.explanation: The cold air dispels sleepiness but loses unease.

findings.highlight: Rin will prepare breakfast. Your priority is recuperating in your room and letting your body heal. If you do not understand this, then I will not hear your answer to my question."
findings.evidenceJa: 朝食の支度など凛がします。シロウが優先すべき事は部屋で休み、体を癒す事です。それが解っていないとは言わせません」
findings.governingReading: She will not let him say he fails to understand that his priority is resting and healing.
findings.explanation: Forbidding a claim of not understanding becomes refusing an answer if he does not understand.

findings.highlight: And it's the right thing to do, to prevent more victims. That's the most important reason we have to fight."
findings.evidenceJa: それに犠牲者を出さないために行動する、なんていうのは当たり前だろ。そんなコト、戦う理由以前の問題だ」
findings.governingReading: Preventing victims is obvious, a matter prior to even discussing reasons to fight.
findings.explanation: Preventing victims as a prior given becomes the highest fighting reason.

findings.highlight: She may not be my Servant, but I have some understanding of her abilities since I've seen her fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 他マスターのサーヴァントと言えど、戦闘を見たのなら能力は数値化できる。
findings.governingReading: After seeing a Servant fight, Shirou can quantify its abilities even when it belongs to another Master. He is uncertain whether the contract or Command Spells enable this.
findings.explanation: Shirou's ability to express observed Servant capabilities numerically becomes merely some understanding of Rider's abilities. The passage does not specify a display or particular numerical values.

findings.highlight: The only other method would be to attack her form a long distance... Like with a magecraft projectile. But Saber has, despite being a knight, remarkable magic resistance, so she can deflect most magecraft."
findings.evidenceJa: 残った手段は遠距離からの攻撃、魔術っていう飛び道具になる訳だけど、セイバーは騎士のクセにとんでもない対魔力を持ってるから、たいていの魔術は弾かれてしまうのよ」
findings.governingReading: The intended forms are from a distance and Did Tohsaka say.
findings.explanation: From and Tohsaka acquire wrong word forms.

findings.highlight: We just need to use magecraft that exceeds Saber's magic resistance, or borrow a weapon wielded by a Servant to cut her head off while she's sleeping... Servants' weapons are spiritual too, so they should be able to hurt her."
findings.evidenceJa: 単にセイバーの対魔力を上回る魔術を持ってくるか、サーヴァントが使ってる武器を借りて、寝ている間に首を切るとか。サーヴァントの武器ならサーヴァント自身と同じ霊格なんだから、傷を付ける事は可能なはずよ」
findings.governingReading: A borrowed Servant weapon has the same spiritual stature as the Servant and therefore should inflict harm.
findings.explanation: The weapon’s equal spiritual rank becomes simply spiritual too.

findings.highlight: "You got it wrong. If Saber was focusing on defending, Rider wouldn't be able to finish her off alone. If Rider isn't a particularly exceptional Heroic Spirit, it wouldn't amount to much, even with her Noble Phantasm in the mix.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ワケないでしょ。セイバーが守りに徹するのなら、ライダー自身じゃ何をしたって追い詰める事なんて不可能よ。ライダー本人がそう優れた英霊じゃないのなら、彼女が宝具を使ったところでタカが知れているし。
findings.governingReading: If Saber fully defends, Rider herself cannot put her into a corner, whatever she does.
findings.explanation: Unable to corner her becomes unable to finish her off alone.

findings.highlight: "Most likely, yes. I believe it was an autonomous weapon that does not rely on Rider's skill, and that it has an effect on the Noble Phantasm itself.
findings.evidenceJa: 「おそらく。ライダーの技や魔力に頼らない自動的な武装、宝具そのものに効果がある物だと思います。
findings.governingReading: The hypothesized autonomous armament depends on neither Rider’s skill nor mana; the effect belongs to the Noble Phantasm itself.
findings.explanation: An intrinsic effect becomes an effect on the Noble Phantasm itself.

findings.highlight: "Eh? Oh, no. It is nothing...but I do believe it is inappropriate for a knight to ask another for their opinion of who is stronger."
findings.evidenceJa: 「え……？　あ、いえ、別にそういう訳ではないと言うか……ええ、本当はどちらが強いかなど、追究するのは騎士にあるまじき行いというか……」
findings.governingReading: She regards pursuing which weapon is stronger as inappropriate knightly competitiveness.
findings.explanation: Pursuing which is stronger becomes asking another’s opinion.

findings.highlight: Even a cursed spear that always strikes the heart is just a sharp spear if you use it against a boulder or a house.
findings.evidenceJa: 必ず心臓を貫く、という呪いの槍とて、相手が岩や家ならただの頑丈な槍にすぎない。
findings.governingReading: Against rocks or houses it is merely a robust/sturdy spear without the heart-targeting function.
findings.explanation: A sturdy spear becomes a sharp spear.
